name: draw by repetition
means: the position occurs a third time -- its identity (Game.position_key: board, side to move, castling, a LEGAL en-passant square) twice in the game record before it (Game.terminal says 'repetition'; Lean Chess.threefoldClaimable, Ideas.Game.chess_threefold_iff)

why.gdl: threefold reads the game's history, not the state: the spec of 76.0 left it out (extension (5) of 76.1 (b) adds it as an input, the game record)
